public_rationale: Acher's 2023 tests found illegal moves in 72 of 73 games with text-davinci-003 [e1]. His January 2025 report documented repeated illegal moves by DeepSeek-R1, a model from another provider [e2]. These results support the historical claim that chess-rule failures persisted across years and extended beyond ChatGPT before June 28, 2025 [e1, e2]. They establish observable failures, not the proposed explanation that LLMs lack world models [e1, e2].
limitations: The tests do not establish the absence of internal world models or a shared cause of the failures [e1, e2].
The reports establish recurrence, not continuous failure or prevalence across all LLMs; both come from the same investigator [e1, e2].
